title: EduRankAI Domain 03 Multimodal Document Benchmark Data Dictionary
description: Comprehensive schema definitions and metadata rules for the synthetic multimodal document evaluation benchmark.

document_inventory.title: Consolidated Statements of Operations (FY2022 - FY2024)
document_inventory.layout_topology: 3-column financial income statement with borderless nested cells, indentation hierarchy, accounting rules, and subtotal lines.

document_inventory.title: Segment Assets & Liabilities Balance Sheet with Footnotes
document_inventory.layout_topology: Segmented balance sheet with multi-tier nested tables and explicit footnote references [1], [2], [3], [*].

document_inventory.title: Quarterly Margin Dynamics (Q1 2023 - Q4 2024)
document_inventory.layout_topology: Grouped multi-bar visualization displaying Gross Margin %, Operating Margin %, and Net Margin % across 8 fiscal quarters with callout annotations.

document_inventory.title: Strategic Performance Briefing & Regional Execution
document_inventory.layout_topology: Mixed multi-column executive briefing featuring two narrative text columns alongside an embedded 4x4 structured summary table.

document_inventory.title: Regulatory Capital Adequacy & Fee Structure Disclosures
document_inventory.layout_topology: Dense, high-information-density table with 8pt micro-typography, nested qualifiers, and tiered footnote asterisks (*, **, ***, †).

document_inventory.title: Distributed LLM Inference Scalability: Throughput vs. Energy Dissipation
document_inventory.layout_topology: Dense dual y-axes technical chart correlating Model Inference Throughput (tokens/s, left axis) with Energy Dissipation (Joules/token, right axis) across batch workloads with variance bands.

document.description: Reference filename of the target synthetic document (PNG or PDF).

question.description: Natural language query evaluating OCR, table extraction, mathematical reasoning, chart interpretation, or hallucination resistance.

type.description: Cognitive task category for the multimodal evaluator.

ground_truth_value.description: Canonical target value. If adversarial, strictly set to 'NOT_PRESENT'.

ground_truth_unit.description: Physical, financial, or statistical unit associated with the value.

tolerance_pct.description: Permissible numerical error margin percentage (0.0 for exact lookups and adversarial traps; 1.0-2.0 for chart approximations).

target_location.description: Spatial/structural grounding within the document layout.

is_adversarial.description: Flag designating out-of-domain or ungrounded trap queries designed to test hallucination resistance.
